chunks: The Shaykh, the jurist, Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. al-Husayn b. Sa'id narrated to us from Suhayl b. Ziyad al-Wasiti from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Rabi' from Muhammad b. Sinan from Abu al-Agharr al-Nakhkhas. He said: I heard al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon him) say:

Fulfilling the need of a believer is better than one thousand accepted Hajj pilgrimages with all their rites, freeing one thousand slaves for the sake of Allah, and equipping one thousand horses in the way of Allah with their saddles and bridles.

key_terms.قَضَاءُ حَاجَةِ الْمُؤْمِنِ: Fulfilling the need of a believer

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of fulfilling the need of a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the immense spiritual value of helping fellow believers, comparing it to the most meritorious acts of worship: accepted Hajj, freeing slaves, and equipping horses for the cause of Allah. This teaching was delivered in the context of encouraging social solidarity, highlighting that service to others can outweigh even the most revered individual acts of worship.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. al-Husayn b. Sa`id narrated to us from Suhayl b. Ziyad al-Wasiti from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Rabi` from Muhammad b. Sinan from Abi’l Aghur al-Nakhas.  He said: I heard al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) say:

Fulfilling the need of a believer is better than one thousand accepted Hajj with its rites, freeing one thousand slaves for the sake of Allah, and preparing one thousand horses in the way of Allah with a saddle and bridle.
